review_notes: Compared with skaudio.cpp::ALLOC_AUDIO_RAM_BUFFER at 44-56. Source initializes the IBMIO audio flag, checks for an installed sound card, allocates a 0x400-aligned source RAM sample buffer sized by glbMemRAMAudioStuff, zeroes/configures it, and enables buffered sound only for selected card types. Firestaff opens a 6000 Hz unsigned 8-bit SDL3 stream lazily on first playback and mixes up to 16 decoded voices; it has no source card-type gate or persistent source RAM buffer, and the startup ordering differs. The playback function is a partial host equivalent, not full source initialization parity.

Compared with skaudio.cpp::ALLOC_AUDIO_TABLES at 60-71. Source allocates the loaded-sound shelf, GDAT short-info table, 20 active-sound structures, a zeroed 8-entry sound list, six additional sound structures, and then initializes the RAM playback buffer. Firestaff transfers authenticated sound entries/sample bindings into its bounded queue and has SDL3 16-voice playback, but does not provide the same table set, separate zeroed source sound list, eager audio-buffer initialization or source table ownership. Sound assets and runtime events have partial equivalents; table/startup parity remains open.

Compared with skcore.cpp::ALLOC_NEW_PICT at 1293-1310. Firestaff's helper computes the payload and header values only; it allocates no pixel buffer, binds no cache index and cannot reproduce source allocation failure or pointer ownership. The picture runtime path remains incomplete.

Compared with skcore.cpp::SOME_RECT_PICT_0b36_0c52 at 1414-1425. Compared with c_dballocx.cpp::SKW_ALLOC_NEW_PICT at 752-764. Firestaff's helper only calculates payload/header values; it does not allocate or return the source-layout buffer and misses the DOS 16-bit total-size wrap. DOS picture-buffer ownership remains open.

Compared with xcoreenh.cpp::ADD_PARTY_CHAMPION at 635-644 and its SELECT_CHAMPION_FROM_GDAT helper at 402-427.
